methodology.order: Seeded shuffled base every five blocks; cyclic Latin rotations balance each mode at every position
methodology.worker: One persistent Python worker; reset data/model registry each run; Python startup/imports excluded; numerical threads fixed at one
methodology.execution: Includes graph/runner setup, dataset split and JSON artifacts, preprocessing, five fits including cached baseline, validation, retry/load, local release and held-out audits
methodology.export: Snapshot materialization measured separately, then compact JSON serialization, gzip level 6 and raw+gzip write completion; no fsync
methodology.excluded: Process startup, directory creation before each run, artifact cleanup after timing, report queries and benchmark analysis

captureProfiles.plain-off: Plain draft/retry semantics; no evidence retained or trace export
captureProfiles.logs-delta: Compact committed/discarded patches plus backend facts, decisions, retry and stage-start metadata
captureProfiles.fp-minimal: FootPrint read/write retention off and no attached collector; core commit/snapshot recording remains
captureProfiles.fp-summary: Summary read/write retention; collector retains read/write keys plus full backend/decision/retry events
captureProfiles.fp-full: Full read/write retention and collector values; snapshot plus events include redundant values, explicitly priced as this profile

methodology.comparability: Scope contains refs, small candidate summaries and scalars. Full/summary retain additional read evidence; payloads are not identical across profiles. All numerical outcomes checked equal.
methodology.limits: Single local machine, small real dataset, warm single-process benchmark; p10/p90 describe observed runs, bootstrap is local uncertainty; no production/GPU/distributed extrapolation

comparisons.interpretation: Paired differences within randomized balanced blocks. Bootstrap resamples block differences; local observational timing, not universal performance.
